title: Leftover-sized calibration; endpoint translation (L label plant was a no-op)
why_new_lock: L nearest-neighbor label shift on 2 mm voxels rounded leftover 0.56–0.90 mm to 0. Written before any L2 y.
question: Is frozen proxyUhat a probability for leftover-sized assignment change, using the same (t, ehat) as L?

y.event: translate frozen endpoints by t*ehat mm; labels L0 unchanged; radial_4
y.t_ehat: reuse work/L/<sid>/plant.json exactly (same leftover vector; do not redraw)

coverage_bin.rule: highest equal-width bin of proxyUhat with n>=20 on the leftover-y pool

win: ECE(proxyUhat) < ECE(U-as-P) on leftover y AND the highest occupied bin (n>=20) has |mean_y - mean_P| <= 0.15. Also require C_plant != C0 (plant must not be a no-op).
fail: any miss or no-op plant. Keep U. Not proxy-hat{U}. Not hat{U}.
forbidden: change t or ehat after seeing L2 y
